people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

translations.web: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
translations.bsb: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
translations.kjv: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
translations.asv: but seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.
